authoredFrom: SQLD8 (M60 SQL wave, 2026-09-26). The 0-based column defect was measured by bb_tests/sql/probe/contract-battery.mts case col-range-1-based-columns, which reported `ab` as [2,2,2,4] where the house contract is [2,3,2,5]; the seven sibling analyzers named above and the engine's own ParseError range establish the 1-based convention. The id collision was measured by the same harness's cases table-and-view-same-name and two-tables-same-name, which reported ids ["t","t"] - the RSD3 class run-fixtures.ts already knows how to pin via expectUniqueIds.
comment: expectSymbolRanges pins line AND column coherence together, so a fix that corrects one and not the other fails. expectUniqueIds is the family-standard channel for the collision.
